# Spectrum Design System

> Themeable, accessible React components (@ds/react) and CSS design tokens (@ds/tokens). Three brands (Diamond, Amber, Opal), light and dark, English and Arabic (RTL), two densities, three radius styles, four shadow levels. WCAG 2.2 AA in every theme.

Use library components instead of raw HTML, only documented props, and tokens instead of raw values. Start with foundations.json for the always-on rules, then fetch a component’s contract before using it.

## Components
- [Alert](https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/alert.md): An alert shows a message about the page or the result of an action: information, success, a warning or an error. Contract: https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/alert.json
- [AppsNotifications](https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/apps-notifications.md): A settings panel with one switch per app, to turn each app’s notifications on or off. Contract: https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/apps-notifications.json
- [Avatar](https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/avatar.md): An avatar represents a person or team with their photo, or their initials when there’s no photo. Contract: https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/avatar.json
- [Button](https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/button.md): A button triggers an action in place: saving a form, opening a dialog, deleting an item. Contract: https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/button.json
- [ButtonGroup](https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/button-group.md): A button group shows related buttons together, spaced or attached into one control. Contract: https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/button-group.json
- [Card](https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/card.md): A card groups content and actions about one subject, such as an article, a product or a person, into a single container. Contract: https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/card.json
- [Checkbox](https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/checkbox.md): A checkbox turns one option on or off, or lets people pick any number of options from a list. Contract: https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/checkbox.json
- [ChooseCard](https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/choose-card.md): Choose cards are large radio buttons: each option is a card with a name, a description and an optional price, and people pick exactly one. Contract: https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/choose-card.json
- [DropdownMenu](https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/dropdown-menu.md): A dropdown menu shows a list of actions or options when people press a button. Contract: https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/dropdown-menu.json
- [Footer](https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/footer.md): The page footer: a copyright line and secondary links such as Privacy, Terms and Help. Contract: https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/footer.json
- [FormField](https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/form-field.md): FormField puts a label, help text and an error or success message around a form control and wires them together, so screen readers announce the label, hint and error with the control. Contract: https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/form-field.json
- [Header](https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/header.md): A page header that introduces a person and their page: avatar, name, job title and the page heading. Contract: https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/header.json
- [InputField](https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/input-field.md): An input field lets people enter a single line of text: a name, an email address, a search term. Contract: https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/input-field.json
- [Link](https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/link.md): A link takes people to another page or place. Contract: https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/link.json
- [Logo](https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/logo.md): The logo shows the product’s mark and name, usually at the start of the navigation bar, linking to the home page. Contract: https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/logo.json
- [MeetingCard](https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/meeting-card.md): A meeting card shows one event in an agenda or schedule: its name, time and attendees, with a color edge for its status. Contract: https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/meeting-card.json
- [Navbar](https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/navbar.md): The navigation bar at the top of a site or app: the logo, links to the main sections, and optional actions such as search. Contract: https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/navbar.json
- [Pagination](https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/pagination.md): Pagination moves between pages of a long list or table. Contract: https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/pagination.json
- [ProductCard](https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/product-card.md): A product card shows one product in a grid or list: photo, name, short description, rating and price, with an optional sale price and actions. Contract: https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/product-card.json
- [RadioGroup](https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/radio-group.md): A radio group lets people pick exactly one option from a short list, with every option visible at once. Contract: https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/radio-group.json
- [Select](https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/select.md): A select lets people pick one option from a list that opens below the field. Contract: https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/select.json
- [Switch](https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/switch.md): A switch turns a single setting on or off and applies the change immediately, like a light switch. Contract: https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/switch.json
- [Tabs](https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/tabs.md): Tabs switch between related views of content in the same place, one at a time. Contract: https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/tabs.json
- [Textarea](https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/textarea.md): A multi-line text field for longer answers such as messages, comments or descriptions. Contract: https://osama-eldrieny.github.io/design-system-ful-example/ai/components/textarea.json
